import re
def digest_insert(top):
    top=top.lower()
    i=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('ggtctc',top)][0]      # forward site (5'-most)
    j=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('gagacc',top)][-1]      # reverse site (3'-most)
    # forward: top cut after i+6 +1 spacer => insert top starts i+7; bottom cut i+11 => left 5' overhang = top[i+7:i+11]
    top_start=i+7; left_oh=top[i+7:i+11]
    # reverse (GAGACC at j): bottom-strand GGTCTC; top strand recessed. top cut at j-1, bottom cut at j-5
    # right 5' overhang (on bottom strand) spans top coords [j-5:j-1]; its top-strand seq = top[j-5:j-1]
    top_end=j-1; right_oh=top[j-5:j-1]
    ds_top=top[top_start:top_end]              # top strand of insert (includes left overhang, recessed at right)
    return left_oh,right_oh,ds_top
def rc2(s):
    c={'a':'t','t':'a','g':'c','c':'g'};return ''.join(c[x] for x in reversed(s))
